citations.claim: at first violating step body 1 is embedded in wall 1 (distance -0.189, overlap exceeds 0.15 limit)
one step before, body 1 was just outside wall 1 falling fast along its right edge
two steps before, body 1 was clear of the wall, showing a fast corner-grazing approach

counterfactual.change: changed body 1 restitution e from 1 to 0; lower bounce speed off the right arena boundary makes the subsequent side impact into wall 1 slow enough for contact resolution, so no penetration occurs.

explanation: Fast small body falls past the sharp top-right corner of wall 1, bounces off the right arena boundary at ~70 m/s, and immediately strikes the wall side/corner. The impulse plus positional correction with 16 substeps cannot resolve the near-simultaneous boundary bounce and box-corner contact, leaving the circle embedded 0.189 into the wall at step 246. Removing the bounce energy (e=0) prevents the deep embed, confirming high-speed corner contact as the cause.
vision_note: The small red body falls down along the right arena edge toward the top of the gray block. At step 246 it ends up overlapping the block's top-right corner where the block meets the boundary.
